name: Fire Element
description: A red crystal that embodies the power of fire. It's found near hot areas, but may also be found in any area that's not unusually cold or dark. It can't be used as an explosive on its own.

name: Water Element
description: A blue crystal that embodies the power of water. It's commonly found near water. The Sage wrote about how to draw power from them, but nobody knows how they come to be.

name: Wind Element
description: A green crystal that embodies the power of wind. It's found in windy places, like grassy plains. Records indicate that they tend to appear anywhere a strong storm has passed.

name: Earth Element
description: A yellow crystal that embodies the power of earth. It's commonly found anywhere there is abundant soil, which makes this the most abundant element in the world.

name: Taun
description: A plant used for basic alchemy. In some worlds it's known as Magic Grass. The area around Westwald is abundant in natural resources, so it can be easily obtained.

name: Uni
description: A spiky nut found in most forests. It may look like a common chestnut, but it has its own unique properties. It is a commonly used item in many regions.

name: Nectar Fruit
description: A sweet, tasty fruit. It's popular as a food item as well as a medicinal ingredient. Monsters often seek it out, making it a somewhat dangerous item to gather.

name: Honey Poppy
description: A flower filled with sweet, fragrant honey. It finds common use as a sweetener and perfume additive. It's also used to soothe sore throats, and is a common children's medicine.

name: Sage Herb
description: A versatile herb with many medicinal uses. Most people don't realize its value due to its plain appearance, but it's incredibly popular among alchemists.

name: Wheat
description: Perhaps the most common grain grown in this world. It is ground up to create a fine white flour that is used in a number of breads and noodles.

name: Dunkelheit
description: A red flower which grows deep in the forest, where little sunlight can reach. It's quite powerful, but can be very difficult to find. It's also said to gather mana within it.

name: Golden Tree Leaf
description: A tree leaf made of solid gold. Due its beauty, some aristocrats plant the trees on their estates. Some people even make their living by gathering and selling the leaves.

name: Darkshroom
description: A mushroom that releases its spores at night. They say that anyone who inhales these spores will grow mushrooms from their head, so all other than alchemists tend to avoid it.

name: Royal Crown
description: A rare mushroom found only at high altitudes. Its alluring fragrance is said to enthrall all who encounter it, which along with its rarity makes it a very costly item.

name: Potable Water
description: Pure drinking water. The water around Westwald is filtered naturally as it comes down the nearby mountains, and many plants cannot grow without this water.

name: Strange Liquid
description: A poisonous liquid. It naturally emits smoke and looks quite dangerous, but the poison is relatively weak. Because of this, it's surprisingly safe to handle.

name: Tar Fruit
description: A nut which contains a muddy, dark liquid. The shell is extremely hard, making it difficult to open up. If you're unlucky, you'll only find a few drops of liquid inside for your efforts.

name: Vegetable Oil
description: Plant oil extracted from tree seeds. Westwald is surrounded by nature, making this an easy ingredient to obtain. It's useful in cooking, as well as an alternative fuel source.

name: Lakebed Reserve
description: Mud collected from the bottom of a lake, which contains the remnants of ancient fossilized organisms. This material contains special properties not usually found in regular sand or soil.

name: Phlogiston
description: A red crystal which gives off sparks when struck against itself (hence its name). Although flammable, it can't be used as a fuel, so it's often processed into materials.

name: Snow Stone
description: A strange stone that's always cold and covered in frost. On top of its alchemic use, it's commonly used to create cheap ice boxes.

name: Raiden Ore
description: A mineral with an electric charge. It makes a deafening noise when struck, so you have to take extra care when gathering it.

name: Broken Stone
description: A stone material created when demolishing buildings. The quality of the item varies so greatly that it's rarely used as is.

name: Sun Crystal
description: Absorbs sunlight, causing it to glow. It's warm to the touch and provides healing properties to the holder, so many people carry this with them as a good-luck charm.

name: Fest
description: A mineral made from small, hard particles. It crumbles when gripped too tightly, so it should be handled with care. It's generally crushed when used in alchemy.

name: Eternal Crystal
description: A crystal composed of tiny snowflakes. It's always cold and never melts, though no one can explain why. Many researchers are working hard to uncover its mysteries.

name: Kimberlite
description: A core ingredient for Diamonds. Its uses are limited, so not much is known about it. People tend to mistake its name for something else...

name: Magnet Stone
description: A magnetic stone. The larger the stone, the stronger the magnetic attraction. This strong force makes it easy to detect when mining for it.

name: Ripple Stone
description: A rock found in areas once submerged beneath the ocean. It's composed of fine sand particles that have hardened into a single rock. Some also have fossils embedded within them.

name: Spirit Rock
description: A stone said to contain spiritual power, although there is no evidence of spirits existing in this world. Still, it does provide a mysterious energy when used as an alchemy ingredient.

name: Steel Balls
description: A standard component of different metals. Smelting this into blades allows for an extremely sharp edge, making it a common element of swords and kitchen knives.

name: Steel Ore
description: A hard, heavy, heat resistant iron ore found deep within the earth. It takes effort to process, but its use in high quality steel armor makes it valuable among swordsmen.

name: Star Piece
description: A chunk of a meteor which fell from the sky. It has many properties not found in materials on Earth, so many people are still researching its uses to this day.

name: Rainbow Corundum
description: A strange jewel streaked with red and blue coloring. Apparently each color embodies the properties of heat and cold, fire and water.

name: Glitter Sand
description: Sand which emits light. Thanks to this property, it's often used as a decoration or component in light fixtures.

name: Rubber Tree
description: A tree with rubbery properties. The branches bend and stretch and are almost impossible to break, making the material very easy to work with.

name: Eiche
description: A common lumber tree. It's quite hard and durable, making it perfect for construction use. In other worlds, it's said that homes built with Eiche are blessed by the fairies.

name: Chainweb
description: A web woven by the Chain Spider. It's much tougher than a normal spiderweb, but without any stickiness. Nobody has ever seen this web being weaved.

name: Golden Threads
description: Silk thread dyed gold. The thread is made by a special type of silkworm which can only survive in very specific environments, so it can only be collected in the wild.

name: Balloon Fish
description: A fish that puffs up like a balloon and unleashes a poison shot when attacked by predators. It can also explode at the slightest touch, so it has to be carefully packaged for shipping.

name: Butterfly Fish
description: A distinct looking fish that resembles a set of butterfly wings. It's popular as a food item, but its glittering scales make it popular as an ornamental pet as well.

name: Wascher
description: A small fish found in just about any river. It can reproduce quickly so it can easily increase its numbers in any new environment.

name: Lobster
description: A crustacean with huge, strong pincers which pose a danger when trying to catch them. Boiling them in an alchemy cauldron makes them rainbow-colored.

name: Old Master
description: A fish whose size, weight, and strength stand above all others. Only a master fisherman can hope to catch one, but its poor taste make it not really worth the effort.

name: Bitter Worm
description: A vivid green earthworm. It owes its color to its diet consisting solely of leaves. Fish don't seem to like it so it makes for poor bait, which is how it got its name.

name: Baby Wyrm
description: A common caterpillar with a dragon-like face. Its face tends to scare off fish, so it's not very useful as bait. It's said to have a fairly sweet flavor.

name: Ladybug
description: A ladybug with a star pattern on its wings. Surprisingly, it's carnivorous and has a tendency to bite, so take extra care when catching them.

name: Leiden Dragonfly
description: A dragonfly with yellow and black spots. It's much bigger than other dragonflies, but has a gentle, friendly nature.

name: Gold Scarab
description: A golden beetle. Little boys love to catch this bug to show off to others, and it can fetch a high price among insect enthusiasts.

name: Dragon Horn
description: A horn from the world's mightiest beast. It's the hardest known substance and contains the life essence of the dragon, so it's often used in alchemy.

name: Dragon Bloodstone
description: Crystallized dragon blood. It's extremely poisonous, so advanced techniques must be used to prepare it for synthesis. In some regions it's known as a Dragon Scab.

name: Dragon Scale
description: A segment of a dragon's skin. It's highly resistant to heat, cold, and most attacks. It's extremely difficult to process, but can be used to make superb armor.

name: Chariot Milk
description: Milk obtained from the Chariot Goat. It's very nutritious and thick with a pleasant flavor, so it's quite popular. However, it can go bad very quickly.

name: Fresh Meat
description: Recently harvested animal meat. It has a lovely color and an elastic texture, making it an extremely popular cooking ingredient.

name: Tough Bone
description: The bone from a large beast. It's very tough and solid, making it perfect for weapons and armor. It's also popular in certain regions as a soup stock.

name: Wool
description: Wool gathered from a common sheep. The fibers are heat resistant and it's a common material for making clothing in Westwald.

name: Wicked Fang
description: A fang extracted from a monster. Most monster fangs have some kind of venom, so take extra care when handling it.

name: Pendant Rock
description: A jewel said to be a crystallization of souls of the living. The center glows with a bluish white light, and it's said that the brighter the light, the better the quality.

name: Puniball
description: A material gained when defeating Punis. It's squishy, just like the Puni, and is a common alchemy material. It's rare for you *not* to get this from a Puni after defeating one.

name: World Spirit
description: A material said to contain the truth of the world. Nobody knew it even existed until alchemists from other worlds arrived. Even in those parallel worlds, not much is known.

name: Monster Feather
description: The feather from a large avian monster. It can be found littering this monster's path, and weaker monsters tend to avoid these areas.

name: Blue Demon
description: An extremely spicy vegetable. On top of being spicy, it has a distinct bitter flavor, which some people seem to love. It's a common ingredient in smelling salts.

name: Red Demon
description: An extremely spicy vegetable. Eating one can cause someone to literally breathe fire. It has a very pungent odor, and is generally diluted before being used in cooking.

name: Ertona Crystal
description: A crystal found in Ertona. It also exists in this world, but was never differentiated from other crystals. It gives off a faint glow.

name: Apple
description: A red fruit which grows on trees. It's sweet and tangy, and cooking it will increase its sweetness even more.

name: Fragrant Chips
description: Wood chips from an aromatic tree. The scent changes based on the tree used, so the materials depend on the intended purpose. It's most often used similar to incense.

name: Bullet Seed
description: A tree seed shaped like a bullet. The shell is very hard and can cause pain when it falls from a tree. Some regions use it for cooking, but its processing method isn't well known.

name: Whimsy Strawberry
description: Despite a similar appearance, strawberry flavors can vary wildly from one species to the next. Some are sweet, while others are surprisingly sour.

name: Silver Liquid
description: A liquid that glows with a silvery shimmer. It has unique properties used in both poisons and medicines. Despite its color, it contains no actual silver.

name: Scrap Metal
description: A piece of junk metal repurposed for other uses. It's worthless as is, so it has to be melted down for reuse. Once in this state, it has many applications in alchemy.

name: Black Sand
description: A magnetic type of sand. Due to this, it's fairly easy to collect. It generally has other minerals mixed in with it, which can lead to some unexpected effects.

name: Ultramarine Soil
description: A strange soil with liquid properties and a lovely blue tint. Crops grown in this soil don't need to be watered, but since it lacks nutrients you have to mix in fertilizer with it.

name: Shining Saucer
description: A mysterious disc found in some ancient ruins. It's used as some sort of recording medium which needs a specialized machine to read.

name: Junk
description: A relic from some ruins. The ruins no longer serve their original purpose, but the items found within cannot be recreated with current technology.

name: White Sand
description: Sand with almost no impurities. It's bright white and glitters in the sun. It's also easy to dye, and is a common component of many art pieces.

name: Princess Grass
description: A hardy plant that grows at altitudes that no other plant can handle. It's a popular ornamental plant and is often used in gift bouquets.

name: Crimson Soil
description: A strange soil with fiery properties. It's dark red and allows for crop growth in areas with little sunlight. It lacks other nutrients, however, so it requires supplemental fertilizer.

name: Green Soil
description: A strange soil with airy properties. It's dark green and allows water to pass through it easily. This makes it good for outdoor training grounds.

name: Unknown Egg
description: Some sort of egg found in forest and mountain areas. It has never been seen to hatch, and some people refuse to eat it because they don't know what kind of animal it is.

name: Animal Hide
description: Leather made from animal skin. It's often used in clothing, and pieces with unique designs tend to fetch higher prices.

name: Vintage Pot
description: An old pot found in ruins and similar areas. These are a common discovery, so they have relatively low value to regular people. Some of them have unique effects.

name: Beehive
description: A great source of honey. It's always full of bees, so of course it's important to avoid getting stung while harvesting the honey.

name: Leafy Lettuce
description: A vegetable popular for its crunchy texture. It's most commonly used in salads, but can also be used to wrap grilled meat in.

name: Shining Crystal
description: Some kind of glittery crystal. It varies in size, but each one has its own detailed pattern, making them very popular accessory components.

name: Fardenlite
description: A fibrous mineral which is highly resistant to heat. The fibers are very fine, so any mistake during processing will cause it to disintegrate.

name: Purple Grape
description: A grape with a sharp tip. The skin is actually quite thick, leaving less fruit than expected. The innards are sour, but the skin itself is sweet. It's commonly eaten whole.

name: Lethe Grass
description: A plant which can temporarily dull pain. Its extracted essence is used as an anesthetic. Despite its name, it does not cause memory loss.

name: Mermaid Tear
description: A jewel generally found at the bottom of lakes or oceans. It got its name from its teardrop shape, although as far as anyone knows, mermaids don't actually exist.

name: Mandra Root
description: A humanoid-shaped plant. Some people think that they scream when you pull them out, but that's just a superstition.

name: Eternal Silver
description: An odd type of ice that never seems to melt. Perfect for chilling drinks, but if eaten by accident, it will remain solid ice until digested, which will leave you with a chilly stomach.

name: Fairy Parasol
description: A common edible mushroom commonly found in hilly areas. You might think it has something to do with fairies, but the person who named it never even met a fairy.

name: Leichester Iron
description: Iron from a fallen meteor which is said to have magical powers. It's nearly impossible to distinguish from a regular stone, but still fetches a high price.

name: Gravistone
description: A stone which can defy gravity and float in mid-air. Using this stone as an ingredient will sometimes pass that attribute on to the item.

name: Carrot
description: A vegetable that can be used for any recipe. It's full of nutrients and can be used as an ingredient for medicine.

name: Neutralizer-B
description: A blue Neutralizer made from refined liquids. The clearer the color, the higher the quality. It takes an expert eye to determine the effects based on the depth of color.

name: Neutralizer-R
description: A red Neutralizer made from refined explosives. It's perhaps the most basic Neutralizer, and just about every alchemist can synthesize it.

name: Neutralizer-G
description: A green Neutralizer made from refined plants. When used to make medicine, it can increase the healing power of the item. The more fragrant it is, the more potent.

name: Neutralizer-Y
description: A yellow Neutralizer made from refined minerals. A vivid color and smooth texture indicates high quality, as this shows that the mineral contents have been fully processed.

name: Ingot
description: An item created by smelting ore. It can be made from different types of ore, which can greatly affect the quality. This is a necessary component of most weapons.

name: Silvalia
description: A piece of metal with a silver glimmer. The more you polish it, the brighter it shines. Because this alloy doesn't exist naturally, it's much harder to make.

name: Gold Eisen
description: A piece of metal with a golden sheen. It's soft and malleable, yet durable. Since it's used to make processed goods, the total gold content is relatively low.

name: Harmonium
description: A legendary element, said to be the supreme metal. Only the best craftsmen can even dream of making it. It shimmers with a prismatic glow.

name: Cloth
description: An ordinary piece of cloth. It's used in many different goods, so the final product can vary wildly. It can also be used as the base for a higher quality cloth.

name: Moffcloth
description: Cloth with a smooth texture. Cotton is the main ingredient, making it easy to process, as well as tough and long-lasting.

name: Flugel
description: A popular cloth light as a feather and soft to the touch. Many craftsmen use it exclusively thanks to its unique features.

name: Velvetis
description: A top-quality cloth known for its beauty, durability, and pleasant texture. They say once you've felt this on your skin, you can't go back to wearing any other material.

name: Comet
description: A jewel made from Sun Crystals. It has a clouded green color by default, but can be polished to a bright shine. Doing this will make it smaller bit by bit.

name: Polishing Powder
description: A powder made from fine, hard particles and used to polish precious metals. When processed into a single solid object, it functions as an effective sharpening stone.

name: Diamond
description: The hardest jewel in the world. It's gold- tinted glimmer never dulls, earning it the nickname "eternal sun". It's very popular as a decorative jewel, especially in engagement rings.

name: Alchemic Clay
description: A clay that can only be created via alchemy. It's easy to process and becomes as hard as iron when sufficiently heated. It's a basic ingredient in a wide variety of goods.

name: Zettel
description: A paper handmade from plants. It can be used just like normal paper, but it's most often used for important documents, as well as an alchemy ingredient.

name: Distilled Water
description: Water that has had all impurities removed. It's used in alchemy to avoid any unwanted reactions, but due to its complete lack of flavor it's rarely used for consumption.

name: Pure Oil
description: An oil that has had all impurities removed. The oil is plant based and has no toxicity, so it sees wide use as an industrial lubricant and cooking agent.

name: Wheat Flour
description: A powder made from grinding wheat. It's a staple ingredient for nations whose diets feature a lot of bread. Flour made via alchemy has a flavor quite distinct.

name: Pure Poison
description: A powerful poison created by a continuous purification and blending method. A single drop is enough to cause mass havoc, so extra caution must be taken when handling.

name: Hollow Ring
description: A ring with powerful magical properties. It tends to leak a small amount of magic continuously, and if it absorbs too much magic, it can shatter easily.

name: Gnade Ring
description: A ring made with alchemy. It can boost the physical abilities of the wearer, and the type of ability boosted depends on the ingredients.

name: Ruby
description: A jewel that shines the color of magma. In this world, it represents passion and vitality, and is often used in decorative medals, ceremonial swords, or necklaces.

name: Sapphire
description: A jewel the color of the deep blue sea. In this world, it represents sincerity and benevolence. It is favored among the nobility and other political leaders.

name: Smaragd
description: A jewel that glows with the color of a lush forest. In this world, it represents wisdom and contentment.

name: Philosopher's Stone
description: One of the ultimate goals of any alchemist. It can be used as an ingredient in literally any synthesis, and any item made using this will be a cut above the rest.

name: Crimson Stone
description: A bright red stone said to embody the power of the dragons. It takes great skill to synthesize one, and items made with it will greatly increase in quality.

name: Ashes of Origin
description: Ashes obtained by burning the Golden Tree Leaf. Normal fire cannot burn the leaf, so you must use a special kind of flame. Using this in a synthesis will bring out an item's potential.

name: Polished Crystal
description: A perfectly polished crystal. You will find no dirt, smudge, or imperfection, and its lovely glow makes it as valuable as any jewel. Alchemical version is of higher quality.

name: Honey
description: Made by honey bees after collecting nectar. It's very sweet, and they say it can never rot or go bad. It's considered more healthy than sugar.

name: Medicine Base
description: A powder which acts as a base for medicines. It has no medicinal effect itself, but allows for better absorption and, thus, efficacy.

name: Gold Nugget
description: A chunk of gold. Alchemy began as an attempt to synthesize gold, but it turns out this is much more difficult than anyone imagined.

name: Alchemy Coal
description: A dense piece of coal made by using lumber or minerals in an alchemical process. It can be heated to higher temperatures than normal, but also burns much faster.

name: Bomb
description: A standard explosive made with alchemy. It has a simple structure, so it's easy to modify. It's a popular item among alchemists, and everyone seems to have their own version.

name: Ice Bomb
description: An icy bomb filled with chilled air. Unlike a normal bomb, it freezes everything in the vicinity when it explodes. It's cold to the touch, and can also be used to cool off on hot days.

name: Lightning Bomb
description: A bomb that unleashes a lightning blast when a shock is applied to it. All parts but the handle are electrified, and the slightest touch will give you a jolt.

name: Globe
description: A spherical representation of the world. Since it comes from a parallel world, it's not useful as an actual map; its only real use is as a bomb.

name: Craft
description: A bomb made using Uni spikes. These spikes will act as shrapnel, potentially injuring the user as well as the target. So try to throw it as far away from you as possible...

name: Meteor
description: A strange bomb that causes meteors to fall from the sky. Most people agree that the materials inside of it attract the meteors, but nobody's sure how it reaches out to the stars.

name: Blitz Core: Void
description: A core filled with destructive power. It unleashes a series of slashes which cut through the enemy. Adding any extra components can totally change it.

name: Healing Salve
description: An ointment which can treat inflammation, cuts, or abrasions. It can be taken orally, but it's less effective and also quite bitter, so people just apply it directly to the skin.

name: Fruit Tea
description: Tea with a sweet, fruity flavor. It goes down smooth and helps to refresh the mind. It's quite popular with students studying for exams and overwhelmed researchers.

name: Nectar
description: A pale red drink with a rich, fruity aroma. The smell is so powerful it can rejuvenate even those who have been completely knocked out.

name: Breezy Aroma
description: A scented candle which has the refreshing aroma of a breeze rolling across an open plain. It's relaxing and also has some medicinal properties.

name: Elixir
description: The ultimate panacea which can heal all kinds of injuries and illnesses. This medicine embodies the very essence of alchemy.

name: Dark Water
description: Water created by extracting and concentrating a variety of poisons. It has a pungent stench, and a single whiff can be dangerous.

name: Spirit Weave
description: A strange cloth apparently blessed by the heavens. It cannot be burned, and its beauty is unparalleled. It was created via alchemy from another world.

name: Codex of Creation
description: A book with information on all things. It is written in an unknown language, but just glancing at it will fill you with knowledge and inspiration.

name: Dragon's Secret
description: Medicine made from dragon's blood. One sip will heal all wounds, inside and out. But getting all the materials is very dangerous.

name: Hell Bomb
description: A more powerful Bomb that utilizes special gunpowder. It's more difficult to handle, but also features an ignition device as a safety measure.

name: Ice Bomb Zero
description: An Ice Bomb surrounded in extra ice to keep it even colder. The cold air inside is more highly compressed, leading to a much bigger and more powerful explosion.

name: Plasma Crystal
description: A crystal housing a powerful lightning blast. It won't shock you, but it's fragile and prone to cracking, so you need to be careful.

name: Globe Cannon
description: A cannon which uses a Globe as its ammunition. It will aim at the target automatically, and won't fire until it's sure will hit what it's supposed to.

name: Zeta Craft
description: An upgraded version of the Craft. The number of spikes has been increased for extra damage, and the spikes themselves have a greater range.

name: Uni Meteor Shower
description: An item that calls down countless Unis in place of meteors. Not only is it more powerful than a standard meteor shower, but the Unis will remain on the ground.

name: Grimoire Blitz
description: A Blitz Core imbued with the power of the Book of Wisdom. It can't contain all the power on its own, so it's wrapped with a special chain.

name: Puni Ointment
description: An ointment marked with a cute Puni logo. It's made from Puni bodily fluids, which may explain the strange sensation you get when using it.

name: Dessert Wagon
description: A wagon filled with sweets such as cakes and macarons. It's perfect for tea parties big and small. Whatever you do, do NOT say anything about the carrots...

name: Energy Sour
description: An improved drink combining nectar, fruit, and medicine. It's more effective than normal Nectar, and the fruit gives it extra nutritional value.

name: In Vitro Aroma
description: An aromatic substance contained in a test tube. The fire inside won't go out even when sealed, and opening it up will allow you to enjoy the fragrance whenever you want.

name: Mist Elixir
description: A vaporized Elixir. Coating your body in this will heal wounds much more quickly than a normal Elixir.

name: Dark Matter Water
description: Liquefied Dark Matter, which is a byproduct of synthesis. It's much more powerful than most other known poisons, and a single drop is enough to cause total anarchy.

name: Aurora Curtain
description: A curtain as lovely as an aurora. Wrapping yourself in this will protect you from all kinds of attacks, and convince your enemy that you're some kind of illusion.

name: Ancient Guide
description: A mysterious book that can display useful info on monsters as you encounter them. The pages will fill themselves in based on the owner's knowledge.

name: Hourglass Pie
description: A pie made with the Dragon Hourglass. As in, it's just stuck right in the middle. Eating the pie will distort your sense of time and allow you to unleash devastating attacks.

name: Fishing Pole
description: A long pole used to catch fish. It uses a fishing line with a hook at the tip, which sometimes also features a lure and some bait.

name: Butterfly Net
description: A net for catching insects. As long as you're quick, you can catch just about anything. Be careful when removing the bug.

name: Shovel
description: A tool for digging or scooping out dirt and gravel. In Westwald, they generally use a wooden stick with a spoon-like tip.

name: Reclamation Tool
description: A kind of multi-tool used to develop the land. It can do just about anything, but because it's so complicated, it's usually faster to just use separate tools.

name: Animal Resonator
description: A tool that converts your voice into animal cries, allowing you to talk to animals. What animal it sounds like depends on the quality.

name: Morgen Light
description: A lantern that gives off a light strong as the morning sun. It can illuminate an entire cave system, so it's very useful when exploring new areas.

name: Gravicrystal
description: A crystallized version of the Gravistone. Touching this to an object will cause that object to float.

name: Wind God's Bag
description: A bag containing the power of wind. Opening it will unleash a blast of air. It's often used when gathering materials to aim at tall trees in order to knock things down.

name: Slumber Incense
description: An incense designed to put dragons to sleep. If you use too much, more powerful dragons will sense it and run off, but if you don't use enough, it won't put them to sleep at all.

name: Cauldron
description: A cauldron for doing alchemy. It looks like a standard cauldron, but alchemists can use it to create all sorts of things.

name: Living Basket
description: A basket created by Marie and Elie. It can detect nearby materials and gather them for you automatically. This allows the user to focus on battle while exploring.

name: Detector
description: An item created by Sophie and Firis. It emits waves that can detect hidden spaces and dimensions. Specifically, it's good for detecting caves, as well as holes dug by monsters.

name: Mana Detector
description: An item created by Klein and Viese. It can detect mana and elements. Keep in mind, these elements are different from the Elements you can gather normally.

name: Truth Eyedrops 2
description: Special eyedrops created by Shallistera and Shallotte. They were originally created for another purpose, but later modified to cut through perception-blocking barriers.

name: Barrier Breaker
description: An item created by all the alchemists together. It's meant to remove the barrier hiding the Granzweit Tree; however, it doesn't have any effect on perception-blocking barrier.

name: Fertile Soil
description: Fertile soil created by Escha and Logy. It can store water and nutrients for a long time, and can help any plant grow, which guarantees the vitality of the plant.

name: Mana Fertilizer
nameJp: 特製・マナケミア肥料
description: A fertilizer created by Raze and Ulrika. Unlike normal fertilizer, this is filled with special plant mana. In other worlds, giving it to Mana will make them very happy.

name: Super Plant Food
description: A special plant food created by Rorona, Totori, and Meruru. It's highly concentrated and must be diluted when used on normal plants.

name: Unity Paintbrush
description: A paintbrush created by Lydie and Suelle. It allows the user to concentrate power into one spot and distribute it at will, like using paint to create a picture.

name: Trilateral Torch
description: An ultimate item which combines the power of all the legendary alchemists. It can affect time, space, and the laws of fate, and even bring forth miracles.

name: Granzweit Fruit
nameJp: グランツヴァイトの実
description: Fruit from the Granzweit Tree. It contains many years' worth of life force, leading to a superb flavor. They thought the Sage created it to deal with the monsters somehow.

name: Custom Trash Can
description: A cleaning item created by Marie. Based on an attack item designed by Shallotte, its new purpose is to help out people who struggle with keeping their homes clean.

name: Mana Drink
description: A drink Klein created for Lita. It's a concentration of elemental powers, with the side effect that your body will start glowing. Mana synthesis possible for several days.

name: Rainbow Pie
description: A pie created by Rorona. It's basically four pies in one; this dreamy pie provides four times the flavor, and four times the fun!

name: Fairy Cold Med.
description: A fairy cold med. created by Ayesha. It's specifically designed for fairies, so it doesn't have any effect on humans.

name: Special Tart
description: A one-of-a-kind tart created by Escha. It's chock full of all of Westwald's special ingredients, and she would like to sell it as a local delicacy.

name: Flying Broom
description: A broom that can fly due to alchemy. The talents of the rider determine how well it can fly. All alchemists can apparently ride it to some degree.

name: Flying Broom2
description: A flying broom with room for two, created by Shallotte. The addition of handlebars makes it easier to control, and the 2nd rider can more easily maintain their own balance.

name: Weird Chest
description: A treasure chest created by Firis. The top features a maze with 3 lead balls. You have to get each one in its hole to open it. Failing 3 times will lead to an unknown punishment.

name: Traditional Bread
description: A common homemade item. It's tough and crunchy, so eating too much will wear out your jaw. It's usually served with soup to dip it in.

name: Stamina Bread
description: A bread bun stuffed with meat and veggies. It's simple, filling, and very nutritious. As a result, it's especially popular with adventurers when they're out exploring.

name: Veggie Bun
description: A bun filled with vegetables. The seasoning is slightly sweet, so even kids who hate vegetables still enjoy it. Some even consider it a kind of candy.

name: Golden Soup
description: A soup made mostly from yellow vegetables. It's highly nutritious, good for digestion, and fills you with strength head to toe.

name: Apple Tart
description: A sweet and slightly tangy tart made with a generous helping of apples. It's popular in many regions, and the flavor will vary slightly depending on the apples.

name: Living Pie
description: A pie brought to life through alchemy. It's oddly squishy, and is said to be more flavorful the more life it has. It's very suspicious of humans, so eating it can be a bit tricky.

name: Beer
description: An alcoholic beverage made by mixing fermented malt with carbonated water. The fragrance and flavor of the wheat is a delicious combination.

name: Blessed Wine
description: A drink made from grapes. It's often served during festivals, which is where the name comes from. The origin and age of the drink greatly affects the quality.

name: Jiggly Pudding
description: A jiggly pudding covered in caramel sauce. It's made from Puniballs, which explains the extreme jiggliness.

name: Deluxe Pancakes
description: A special kind of pancake based on a secret recipe. It has a calming effect, making it a popular dessert for adventurers after a long trip.

name: Simple Sweets
description: A baked snack made using alchemy. The simple recipe makes it easy to modify, so the flavor can change greatly depending on the alchemist making it.

name: Alchemy Drops
description: A hard candy made using alchemy. It's actually quite good for you; letting it dissolve in your mouth will grant a healing effect. There are a large variety of flavors.

name: Puni Jelly
description: A jelly made from Punis. It combines many different Puni extracts, giving it a refreshing taste and distinct texture. It's popular with children.

name: Mushroom Stew
description: A pot that cooks automatically once you add a set of ingredients. It will also decide the optimal seasonings and cooking method depending on the ingredients added.

name: Strength Meat
description: A meat dish that grants you extra strength. It looks like pretty plain, but it actually takes a variety of techniques to cook.

name: Apple Story
description: A gathering of every apple in the known world. They're served uncooked, so you can enjoy each apple's natural flavor.

name: Ether Ink
description: A dark ink containing a lot of iron. It has different effects depending on what you put it on, but in every case it will turn the object jet black.

name: Pure Incense
description: An incense with a highly aromatic smoke. Monsters tend to hate the smell, so they'll avoid you as long as it's burning. Humans are fine with it, and the smoke isn't harmful.

name: Pocket Watch
description: A round watch that can open on its own and ring a bell to warn you when danger is approaching. If it's a threat you've never encountered before.

name: Genug Water Pot
description: A magic water pot that can make it rain. It's good for growing vegetables, but it extracts moisture from the air, so you have to be careful not to overuse it.

name: Mirage Mirror
description: A mirror whose reflection appears through a thin haze. They say it connects to another world, and can summon different items from it. These items are random.

name: Speculator Dice
description: A good-luck charm among gamblers. The common belief is that having it on you will bring good fortune, but there's no evidence to support the claim.

name: Crystal Ball
description: A clear crystal which is carved and meticulously polished. It's popular among fortune tellers and the upper class. It takes a lot of time and effort to get it perfectly round.

name: Music Box
description: A wooden box that fits in your palm. Turning the crank will play a little tune, which can have a calming effect. Some people also refer to it as a hand organ.

name: Healing Aroma
description: A scented item that's easy to make. You can repurpose waste oil to make it, but it's more common to use natural fresh ingredients.

name: Magical Paint
description: A paint with magical properties. Painting certain patterns on your body will imbue you with special powers for a brief time. You can also use it like regular paint, if you want.

name: Discharge Tube
description: A special electrical tube. The voltage inside is so high that it has to release some of its charge at all times. This discharge is so small that there's no threat.

name: Gold Puni Statue
description: A golden Puni statue. It's made of solid gold, not merely gold-plated like some other statues. The gold is the only reason it's worth anything.

name: Gramophone
description: An item that lets you record sounds. You can record and play back at the touch of a button. You can record for as long as you want, but you can only record a single time.

name: Bear Doll
description: A strange doll that seems to recall memories from days long past. Everyone seems to see a different expression on its face when they look at it.

name: Crystal Weight
description: A balance weight made from a large amount of high-quality Holy Crystal. It's extremely pretty, but has no practical function.

name: B/W Tarot
description: A recreation of the mysterious painting from Lydie and Suelle's world. They aren't able to create an exact facsimile in their own parallel world.

name: Scattershot
description: A folding-stock rifle. It's more powerful than usual, but also has a huge recoil. You'd have to be pretty strong to use it. It can also accept special cartridges, so it's quite versatile.

name: Claiomh Solais
description: A holy sword also known as the Thunder God. As the name suggests, it contains the power of lightning, and exists to slay evil. It's considered a sword of heroes.

name: Storm Drill
description: A giant drill designed never to break. It can easily pierce rock or iron. It spins so fast it tends to destroy whatever it touches, so it's not really good for detailed or delicate jobs.

name: Crystal Fang
description: A sword made by alchemy to process crystals. It outputs a huge amount of power, so it is difficult to wield. Not only do you need to be adept as a swordsman, but also as an alchemist.

name: Maiden's Spear
description: A spear with a long handle, which makes it good for both thrusting and blunt impact. The length does make it difficult to wield, so only seasoned warriors can use it effectively.

name: World Splitter
description: An axe said to have the power to split both heaven and Earth when swung just right. Its appearance alone seems almost divine.

name: Armored Bunker
description: A powerful weapon that uses explosives to launch a spear. It can easily pierce iron armor, but it takes a lot of skill to aim due to its weight.

name: Bloody Claw
description: A pair of swords that are usually blue as the sky. However, once it tastes the blood of a living creature, it turns an ominous crimson color.

name: Shooting Star
nameJp: シューティングスター
description: A heavenly bow. Special paint is used on the arrowhead, allowing you to track its flight like a shooting star.

name: Goddess Shield
description: A shield with an intricate carving of a guardian goddess. The goddess is from a legend from Shallie's world, and it's unknown if her blessing may reach this world as well.

name: Battle Mail
description: A simple set of metal armor. Although it has no special powers compared to other armor made with alchemy, it's still much stronger than a normal set of armor.

name: Meteorite Armor
description: Armor which uses meteoric iron in its construction. Some believe the armor itself came from outer space, which makes it of interest to researchers.

name: Alchemic Mail
description: Armor made primarily from metals made through alchemy. It's possible to add many different special effects to it, so each set is unique to the person who made it.

name: Dragoon Mail
description: Armor made from dragon materials. It can reflect almost any blow, and is perhaps the best armor in existence. It's lightweight, making it very easy to move around in.

name: Maiden Armor
description: The so-called bikini armor popular in a certain region long ago. Despite its looks, it provides a surprising amount of defense and mobility.

name: Valkyrie Cloth
description: Armor modeled after that worn by the Valkyrie goddesses from another world. It's both practical and aesthetically pleasing, and emits a mystical aura.

name: Cough Drop
description: Designed to soothe the throat. It comes in a variety of flavors, so everyone can find one they like. There are even really odd ones, like meat or carrot flavor...

name: Medical Herb Tea
description: Tea containing medicinal herbs. In addition to a relaxing effect, drinking this will make you feel more healthy overall. It also has a pleasant aroma and refreshing flavor.

name: Eye-Opener
description: A mysterious eye drop that can make invisible things visible. Essentially, it lets you see things that are there, but cannot be seen.

name: Refresh Medicine
description: An effective medicine to treat motion sickness. People generally take it when traveling by ship or carriage.

name: Migraine Syrup
description: A medicine good for treating migraines. It has a sweet flavor to make it easy to take-- in fact, if you drink it when you don't have a migraine, it would taste TOO sweet.

name: Berg Medicine
description: A medicine named after a hunter who came up with it while out hunting in the mountains. It has only a mild effect, but it's relatively easy to make out in the field.

name: Witch Salve
description: A poison created by a witch from a parallel world. It causes extreme pain for a long time wherever it's applied. It's great for when you want someone to suffer...

name: Cold Medicine
description: Cold medicine made using alchemy. It treats fever, runny nose, headache, and sore throat. It's quite bitter and smells awful.

name: Forbidden Capsule
description: A capsule containing an abnormally strong medicine. It can cure illness, but its powerful effect puts a massive strain on the body. It should only be used in an absolute emergency.

name: Vitality Pill
description: A pill that gives you a boost of energy. It only boosts your own internal energy, so it's not effective as a general panacea.

name: Drachen Elixir
description: A hyper medicine made from the life force extract of a dragon. At least, that's what they say... You won't gain the strength of a dragon.

name: Mystery Elixir
description: An amazing medicine that can instantly heal any illness or injury. It requires rare materials and a highly skilled alchemist, so it's extremely rare.

name: Heal Bandage
description: A bandage coated with medicine designed to dull pain. Wrapping it around the affected area will begin the healing process, although you'll still need to rest.

name: Refuel Pads
description: A poultice for treating external injuries. It's a common first-aid treatment in Shallie's world and can be found in pretty much every household.

name: No-Doc
description: A medicinal item that some believe can heal any injury. However, evidence suggests it's not nearly that strong, so you should still see a doctor in most cases.

name: Cloth Skirt
description: A piece of women's clothing. Its simple design makes it a good practice item for those just learning how to sew.

name: Gorgeous Dress
description: Made from cloth thinner than paper. It feels almost weightless, but the cloth is of such high quality it can act as a piece of armor.

name: Leather Coat
description: A fine coat made from tanned animal leather. It's durable and waterproof, so with the proper care it can last quite a long time. It's very popular among adult men.

name: Farden Coat
description: A coat made from Fardenlite, a heat-resistant mineral. It's quite warm itself, and can easily survive being tossed in a bonfire.

name: Concealing Skin
description: A hood that changes color depending on the surrounding environment. It allows you to camouflage yourself from enemies.

name: Sturdy Shirt
description: A shirt made from a tear-resistant material. The cloth is breathable, but is thick enough that it retains a pleasant amount of heat.

name: Stylish Shirt
description: A colorful, fashionable shirt. It's quite flashy and stands out even when seen from a distance. It's also tough enough to be used as armor.

name: Bridal Blouse
description: A blouse designed to look like a bride's dress. It's also been altered using alchemy so that any maiden who wears this will come to no harm.

name: Nightshade
description: An outfit as dark as midnight. Wearing this at night will make you nearly invisible. However, wearing it during the day will make you stand out.

name: Fantastic Wig
description: A wig that weighs exactly 51 kg. It's a huge afro, which nobody wanted. A normal person couldn't--or rather, wouldn't--wear it.

name: Glass Tiara
description: A glass hair accessory adorned with jewels. It's quite lovely, and makes a perfect gift for anyone wanting to look like a princess.

name: Spirit Earrings
description: Earrings decorated with wondrous natural jewels. Some believe the jewels contain the power of mana, and grants nature's protection.

name: Ares Brooch
description: A lovely brooch originally designed by Sophie as a gift. It has a special property where it will glow with an inner light when there is little or no sunlight.

name: Mythical Ring
description: A ring designed in the image of a relic of the gods. Wearing it will grant you strength, and also let you bend time and space, and reduce negative effects around you.

name: Sun Flower
description: A strange flower that emits light during the day, and dims at night. It's the exact same color as sunlight, so it can be difficult to spot at times.

name: Granate
description: A reddish jewel. Wearing it will fill you with passion, making all your endeavors successful. Although it's a jewel, smaller ones are fairly inexpensive and easy to find.

name: Timber
description: A common source of lumber. It's often found in desks, cupboards, and other typical furniture. It's easy to shape and assemble, so even amateurs can work with it.

name: Spruce
description: A processed wood material. It's much more durable than raw wood, so it's common to build items using this.

name: Dense Wood
description: Thick wood made by compressing multiple pieces of lumber together to form a single plank. It's very rigid and resilient, and is used often in construction.

name: Iron Board
description: A board made of metal. It's useful in building all different kinds of facilities. It's easy to use, but requires different processing technology than its wooden counterpart.

name: Liquid Metal
description: A metal with liquid properties. It can also activate the properties of other materials, making it very useful among alchemists.

name: Ultimate Steel
description: The very best construction material that alchemy can make. It has a divine power that can fix any distortions or imperfections in the material.

name: Distorted Stone
description: A common stone used for construction. Due to its odd shape, it's only used for simple structures. It's easy to find, however, so it can be bought in huge quantities for cheap.

name: Colorful Brick
description: A building material that comes in a variety of colors. It's no different from a normal brick, but structures made with this will look much more unique.

name: Magic Stone
description: A stone imbued with magic. It's processed to make it weather-resistant, allowing the building to last longer.

name: Fireproof Plate
description: A strong composite board that's very heat-resistant. It won't melt or distort even when tossed in magma, making it a perfect construction material.

name: Synthesis Piece
description: An essential synthesis component. Using the right tool for the right job is always crucial to making a quality item, so knowing how to use this item properly is always important.

name: Instrument Set
description: An item needed for synthesis requiring detailed measurement. This can give accurate weight readings, and spot things that can't be seen with the naked eye.

name: Ice Box
description: Just add ice to keep its contents nice and chilly. It's made with alchemy, so frozen items inside will never melt. Once you have one, you're good to go for the foreseeable future.

name: Fertilizer
description: Nutrient-rich soil. Plants grown in this will grow faster and bigger, and bear more fruit.

name: Pitchfork
description: A necessary tool for any ranch. It's typically used to carry hay to feed the animals, or move wheat around--anything soft, pretty much.

name: Display Mannequin
description: Used in boutiques to display clothes. It's shaped like a person so customers can see how an item might look on them.

name: Store Shelf
description: Used to store a variety of items. Since it's mostly for display, it can't bear too much weight. But anything displayed on it will seem special.

name: Petrified Wood
description: Dense wood that's as hard and heavy as metal. It doesn't rot and doesn't require much processing, so it can be used just about forever.

name: Rich Soil
description: Fine soil used to grow crops and other plants. Water and nutrients circulate well in this soil, allowing roots to spread and grow easily.

name: Water Pump
description: A necessary item for any facility which needs a high volume of water. It's designed to recycle and reuse a certain amount of water, so that it doesn't use too much.

name: Tough Alloy
description: An extremely tough plate, much harder than ordinary metals. Toss a Bomb at it and it still won't budge. It's an excellent component for buildings or fortifications.

name: Precision Block
description: A block with extremely specific weight and dimensions. Since they're all exactly the same size, it's easy to stack them perfectly straight up.

name: Aurora Crystal
description: A large crystal decoration that shines like an aurora. It's used mainly as an ornamental embellishment, giving a building a grandiose aura.

name: Rainbow Paint
description: Paint with a prismatic sheen. Using this on a building will make it sparkle and give it a unique sense of presence not achievable any other way.

name: Chainsword
description: A tool used to gather lumber. The many blades rotate quickly to allow for the easy felling of trees.

name: Heat Lamp
description: A light fixture used to dry out marshes. Its heat is nearly as strong as the sun, drying out areas in an instant. It's potentially very dangerous.

name: Stainless Frame
description: A rust-proof steel frame. It can be placed in water indefinitely with no risk of rusting, and is also good for use in rainy areas.

name: Mountain Destroyer
description: A Bomb powerful enough to change the landscape itself. It's so dangerous that its use requires approval from both alchemists and local administrators.
